item.miragemask.mirage_mask.desc1: Hold right-click to put the mask on for 60 seconds
item.miragemask.mirage_mask.desc2: Everyone sees you as a mob, a villager or a copy of another player. The mask moves from your hand to your face and returns to your inventory
item.miragemask.mirage_mask.desc3: G - keep look, H - reveal face / resume. A hit breaks the mask
command.miragemask.bad_mob: The mask cannot turn you into %s
